description: The file defines a TasksViewModel class in Kotlin, responsible for managing and exposing task list data and actions for the UI layer in an Android application. It interacts with a TasksRepository to perform CRUD operations on TaskEntity objects, initializes sample tasks if the database is empty, and provides methods for adding, updating, completing, deleting, and restoring tasks.

classes.name: TasksViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel managing a list of tasks for the UI, providing methods for CRUD operations, and initial task seeding.

methods.name: seedIfEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the task repository is empty and seeds it with default tasks if so.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Adds a new task with given title, description, and due date.

methods.name: updateTask
methods.description: Updates an existing task with new title, description, and due date.

methods.name: setCompleted
methods.description: Sets the completion status of a task.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Deletes a task from the repository.

methods.name: restoreTask
methods.description: Restores a previously deleted task, used for undo operations.

methods.name: getTaskById
methods.description: Retrieves a task by its ID asynchronously.
